name: openscout
description: OpenScout plugins: Scout for Claude Code, and Scout Studio in the thread.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Add /scout:* commands and push broker-routed Scout messages into a running Claude Code session.

plugins.name: scout-studio
plugins.description: Show the screenshots this session took, and point the person at one spot on a screen. In apps that draw MCP Apps, the screens and the marked spot show in the thread.
